selectionContract.precisionLimitedPlatform: select precision-first when calibration error dominates routing and mixer count
selectionContract.couplerCountLimitedPlatform: select transform-first when implementing the integral coordinate mixer dominates
selectionContract.gramRoutingLimitedPlatform: select gram-first when physical pair routing of the transformed quadratic form dominates
selectionContract.turnsRatioLimitedPlatform: select balanced-small-ratio when the maximum signed transformer ratio is the binding fabrication constraint
selectionContract.forbidden: do not declare one basis universally optimal without measured platform cost weights

requiredMeasurements: error covariance of the calibrated 24-port admittance matrix
loss and bandwidth cost per nonzero transformer coefficient
layout or control cost per nonzero Gram pair
penalty for the largest signed turns or parametric-coupling ratio
missingPhysicalDictionary.use: convert the abstract Pareto frontier into a platform-specific expected spectral and inverse-metric error

established: the finite scan does not select one universal hardware basis; it supplies four mutually nondominated sub-1000-condition designs tied to explicit physical bottlenecks
boundary: The shortlist is Pareto-nondominated within the declared scan objectives and candidate set, not over all GL(24,Z). The scalar hardware costs and correlated error model must be measured on a chosen platform before one design can be selected.
